rubric.description: Lists all input combinations for two Boolean inputs.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for showing 00, 01, 10 and 11 as the input combinations.

rubric.description: Gives the correct AND output for every input combination.

items.followUp: What is the purpose of a patent law?

rubric.why: Copyright law protects the rights of creators over their work.
rubric.description: States that copyright law protects creators and their intellectual property.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying protection of creators or their work.

rubric.why: A key purpose is to prevent unauthorized copying or use.
rubric.description: Explains that the law prevents unauthorized copying or use of a work.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for mentioning unauthorized copying, use or distribution.

modelAnswer: Copyright law protects the rights of creators over their original work.
It prevents others from copying, using or distributing that work without permission.

rubric.why: Encryption changes data from a readable form into an unreadable form.
rubric.description: Describes the conversion of readable information into an unreadable form.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for explaining this conversion.

rubric.why: Encryption is used to protect information from unauthorized access.
rubric.description: States that encryption secures data against unauthorized access.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for mentioning protection or prevention of unauthorized access.

modelAnswer: Encryption is the process of converting readable data (plain text) into an unreadable form (cipher text).
It protects the data from being understood or accessed by unauthorized people.

items.followUp: What is meant by a server?

rubric.why: A client is a computer or device on a network.
rubric.description: Identifies a client as a computer or device.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying the client device.

rubric.why: A client requests services or resources from a server.
rubric.description: Explains the client’s role in requesting network services or resources.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that it requests services or resources from a server.

modelAnswer: A client is a computer or device on a network that requests services or resources from a server.

rubric.why: FTP stands for File Transfer Protocol.
rubric.description: Gives the full form of FTP.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for the correct expansion of FTP.

rubric.why: FTP is used to transfer files between computers over a network.
rubric.description: States the purpose of FTP as transferring files between computers.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for describing file transfer between computers or networked devices.

modelAnswer: FTP stands for File Transfer Protocol.
It is used to transfer files between computers over a network.

rubric.why: Data communication involves exchanging or transmitting data.
rubric.description: States that data communication is the exchange or transmission of data.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for mentioning data or information being exchanged or transmitted.

rubric.why: The communication takes place between devices through a communication medium.
rubric.description: Identifies communicating devices and the medium or connection between them.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for referring to two or more devices communicating through a medium or network.

modelAnswer: Data communication is the exchange or transmission of data between two or more devices.
The devices communicate through a communication medium or network.

items.followUp: Give two examples of hardware that can be shared on a network.

rubric.why: Hardware sharing means making hardware resources available to network users.
rubric.description: Defines hardware sharing as sharing hardware resources among users on a network.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for explaining that network users share hardware resources.

rubric.why: Examples clarify what kinds of hardware can be shared.
rubric.description: Gives a valid example of shared hardware.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for one or more valid examples, such as a printer, storage device or scanner.

modelAnswer: Hardware sharing means making hardware resources available for use by different users on a network.
For example, network users can share a printer or a storage device.

items.followUp: What is an ordered list in HTML?

rubric.why: A definition list contains terms or items to be defined.
rubric.description: Identifies the term or item entries in a definition list.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that the list contains terms, words or items.

rubric.why: Each term is accompanied by its definition or description.
rubric.description: States that the list provides a definition or description for its terms.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for mentioning definitions, descriptions or explanations of the terms.

modelAnswer: A definition list is an HTML list used to display terms and their definitions or descriptions.
It uses the <dl> tag for the list, <dt> for a term and <dd> for its definition.
